context: A toy causal system for validating metadata-only causal discovery runs. Study effort affects exam score, and exam score affects course pass status.

variables.name: StudyEffort
variables.description: A pre-exam behavior representing how much time and focus a student spends preparing.

variables.name: ExamScore
variables.description: A post-study assessment representing the student's measured exam performance.

variables.name: PassCourse
variables.description: A final course outcome determined after exam performance is observed.
